nodes.label: Frontend ownership map
nodes.description: Application, feature, transport, presentation, widget, overlay, website practice, routing, and draft restoration responsibilities.

nodes.label: Extension implementation ownership
nodes.description: Stable entrypoints, single mutable worker session, serialized service composition, content facade, inference transport, hooks, and settings owners.

nodes.label: Passive guidance and accessible feedback
nodes.description: Noninteractive overlay geometry, polite panel announcements, focus management, user-controlled actions, and automated versus native accessibility evidence.

nodes.label: Shared presentation boundary
nodes.description: Shared guidance presentation and callbacks with no browser privileges, credentials, completion authority, or app-specific storytelling.

nodes.label: Website implementation ownership
nodes.description: Feature-local website state, controlled practice, canonical legal ownership, stable documentation aliases, mocked accounts, and consent boundaries.

nodes.label: Incremental live discovery
nodes.description: Cooperatively scans semantic/custom controls, open shadow roots, and authorized frames; retains up to 5,000 session controls while projecting at most 600 for planning.

nodes.label: Validated live observation
nodes.description: Bounded current control metadata includes structural context while geometry, state, eligibility, and risk remain independent of semantic identity.

nodes.label: Fresh eligible element binding
nodes.description: Document control IDs bind actual elements; changed meaning or recycled nodes invalidate signatures and binding. Only current eligible targets may be highlighted or scrolled.

nodes.label: Shared NavigationCore
nodes.description: Coordinates request interpretation, retrieval, grounded planning, queues, contextual workflows, visual fallback, and bounded return routing outside browser lifecycle/transport.

nodes.label: Persistent journey objective
nodes.description: Retains the destination independently of current controls, using verified transitions and documented milestones; future steps require live rebinding.

nodes.label: Evidence-based return routing
nodes.description: Uses observed dismissal controls, relevant task predecessors, or associated tabs without assuming forward operations are reversible.

nodes.label: Bounded recovery
nodes.description: Missing or insufficient evidence leaves the journey incomplete and triggers bounded recovery rather than an invented website route.
nodes.rationale: Unobserved and omitted controls do not prove route absence; an unsupported prediction cannot become an action.

nodes.label: Task-specific outcome verification
nodes.description: The extension verifies actual selected values, destinations, created items, deployment or membership states; wrong outcomes and unrelated toasts do not advance a task queue.

nodes.label: Low-evidence viewport OCR
nodes.description: Default Tesseract runs in a separate local worker only when discovery evidence is insufficient; DOM bindings take precedence and OCR cannot prove completion.

nodes.label: Experimental Paddle OCR
nodes.description: Included only by an explicit experimental build; startup/promotion gates have not passed and normal builds exclude it.

nodes.label: Reusable IndexedDB knowledge
nodes.description: IndexedDB v5 stores reusable site knowledge and parameterized saved routes separately from private active-session context; incompatible derived indexes rebuild.

nodes.label: Optional Fastify/SQLite mirror
nodes.description: Explicitly connected single-owner service mirrors reusable knowledge with v1 compatibility and v2 workflow/visual negotiation; browser authority and local fallback remain.

nodes.label: Pinned session identity
nodes.description: Session token, browser tab, document, protocol, and origin are pinned; back/forward and same-document history trigger fresh binding scans.

nodes.label: MV3 session restoration
nodes.description: Worker restores trusted session storage while the content coach continues through suspension; restoration validates current session, tab, document, and origin.

nodes.label: Session-scoped presentation visibility
nodes.description: Expanded, minimized, and hidden presentation are separate trusted state; suppressing overlays need not stop authorized observation or verification.

nodes.label: Pinned-tab command rejection
nodes.description: Guide/Get Page/Resume from another active tab are rejected; closing the pinned tab clears the active session while Stop/Pause can clear it from the panel.

nodes.label: MV3 lifecycle evidence
nodes.description: Chromium tests stop the real worker in running/waiting/paused states and use a changed test-only epoch rather than wrapper-close events to prove restart.

nodes.label: Authored Northstar regression routes
nodes.description: Two controlled versioned fixture packs use semantic landmarks, expected state transitions, exact origins, and explicit boundaries; they are separate from product live discovery.

nodes.label: Terminal irreversible-action boundary
nodes.description: Final irreversible authored actions have no outgoing transitions; login checkpoints and declared visible success evidence are distinct states.

nodes.label: Dynamic navigator.live mode
nodes.description: The worker exposes navigator.live version 1.0.0 for HTTP/HTTPS; it uses observations and goal plans rather than pretending to be an authored route graph.

nodes.label: Live/authored payload isolation
nodes.description: Live views require valid unique current visible/enabled control IDs; authored views reject generic page/control/goal payloads and both modes reject route/version substitution.

nodes.label: Structural heading and region context
nodes.description: Generic HTML/ARIA heading ancestry, named regions, enclosing sections, and document/shadow-root ownership distinguish repeated controls without site-specific selectors.

nodes.label: Generic context specificity
nodes.description: Extra qualifiers in a nearest section reduce rank; unknown scope remains unknown, structural changes invalidate signatures/revisions, and geometry is not model input.
nodes.rationale: Repeated control labels require semantic context without encoding website names or routes.

nodes.label: Experimental Chrome Prompt API interpretation
nodes.description: Opt-in local model proposes structured intent and current IDs from bounded sanitized evidence; it has no selector, action, or completion authority.

nodes.label: Retrieved current-control model view
nodes.description: Ranks requested purpose and terms, keeps discovered openers, and bounds model input to 96 controls and about 24,000 characters; cannot recover undiscovered controls.

nodes.label: Pristine cancellable model request
nodes.description: Each request clones and destroys a pristine Prompt API session with cancellation and a 30-second timeout; current task context includes up to eight verified interactions.

nodes.label: Independent model-intent grounding
nodes.description: Planner requires one eligible live route, matching current IDs and operation/control kind, user-sourced qualifiers, and retained consequential/unknown-effect boundaries.

nodes.label: Bounded English task interpretation
nodes.description: Compromise parses the entire validated English request with order, negation, corrections, and desired values; maximum 1,000 characters and three explicit tasks.

nodes.label: Compromise/BM25/MiniLM pipeline
nodes.description: Sanitized semantic metadata feeds BM25 and normalized mean-pooled MiniLM vectors alongside semantic/observed-route planning; current state is validated separately.

nodes.label: Versioned derived embedding cache
nodes.description: SHA-256 plus pinned model revision keys a global 10,000-entry derived cache that can rebuild independently of original knowledge.

nodes.label: Packaged CPU offscreen inference
nodes.description: Chrome offscreen document owns worker-based packaged q8 ONNX MiniLM with one CPU thread and packaged WASM; no remote model is required.

nodes.label: Inference cancellation and unloading
nodes.description: Foreground planning preempts suggestions between model calls; Stop aborts pending work and closes offscreen resources, and idle resources unload after two minutes.

nodes.label: Verified multi-task queue
nodes.description: Queue advances on requested observed results; search focus is intermediate, review blocks, Skip records skipped, Pause retains, and Stop cancels.

nodes.label: Request/document/scan revision guards
nodes.description: Plans carry identifiers tying asynchronous work to current request, document, and observation revision; changed scans replan from the original sentence.

nodes.label: Explicit observation activation
nodes.description: Discovery starts on Guide me or explicit page exploration; panel opening alone does not observe. Pause/Stop remove discovery/invalidation observers and Resume rescans.

nodes.label: Bounded value-free observation
nodes.description: Reads bounded labels, authored descriptions, roles, headings, form metadata, relationships, and interaction state; excludes editable values, passwords, OTPs, and raw HTML.

nodes.label: Authentication continuity without credential handling
nodes.description: Field metadata and bounded form context detect authentication; the objective survives credential/two-factor waiting without an expiry deadline, while the user authenticates.

nodes.label: Trusted private session context
nodes.description: chrome.storage.session retains active requests, supplied values, entities, unfinished journeys, and the task ledger; private names, statuses, and vectors do not enter reusable knowledge.

nodes.label: Bounded reusable memory retention
nodes.description: Limits reusable memory to 50 sites, per-site 100 pages/120 states/30 templates/400 transitions, 100 saved routes, and 90-day access-time expiry; derived cache has 10,000 entries.

nodes.label: Forget/Clear knowledge controls
nodes.description: Observation stops before deletion; Forget removes a website and traversing routes, Clear removes knowledge/routes/indexes, uninstall removes extension-owned data, and failed mirror deletion is reported.

nodes.label: Editable-field and iframe OCR masks
nodes.description: Capture hides Tholi overlays and masks discovered editable fields including open-shadow fields plus every iframe rectangle, even when frame DOM guidance is authorized.

nodes.label: Trusted draft and conversation storage
nodes.description: Preferences/bounds are local; draft and at most 80 messages stay in trusted extension-session storage, separate from website and cloud. Widget commands are session/document bound.

nodes.label: Session-only mock website accounts
nodes.description: Website accounts are explicitly fake; name/email/onboarding live in browser-session storage, passwords are neither persisted nor transmitted, and sign-out clears the mock account.

nodes.label: Consent-gated website appearance storage
nodes.description: Host-only SameSite=Lax consent lasts 180 days; optional theme cookie requires appearance consent, withdrawal deletes it, and blocked cookies preserve in-memory usability.

nodes.label: Inactive allowlisted analytics boundary
nodes.description: No production provider is configured. Future consent-bound events may include only public page categories, downloads, and two fixed practice task IDs; arbitrary private/user text is excluded.

nodes.label: Bounded redacted local diagnostics
nodes.description: Diagnostic exports omit labels, goals, paths, raw DOM, and field values; authenticated screenshots/traces are not captured by default.

nodes.label: All observed/model evidence is untrusted
nodes.description: Page text, observations, stored knowledge, documented predictions, and model outputs never independently authorize action or completion; fresh eligibility and signatures are required.
nodes.rationale: Website evidence and model suggestions may be stale, malicious, or mistaken; authority remains in validated runtime contracts and observed results.

nodes.label: Explicit per-origin host access
nodes.description: Default hosts are English Wikipedia and local development; other HTTP/HTTPS sites require specific grants. DOM and screenshot permissions are distinct.

nodes.label: Trusted sender and document validation
nodes.description: Extension commands require extension-owned sender identity; content messages require assigned tab/frame/document and validated contracts; stale results cannot replace current documents/tasks.

nodes.label: Consequential and unknown-effect review
nodes.description: Users execute clicks/input/submissions; review explains consequential or unknown effects and starts verification after a user click. Heuristic risk cannot prove arbitrary server behavior.

nodes.label: Single-owner API protection
nodes.description: Loopback default, bearer token, explicit extension-origin CORS, and HTTPS for remote hosting guard an optional service whose credentials remain trusted and whose private payloads are unpersisted.

nodes.label: Pending native and signed-in acceptance
nodes.description: Synthetic Chromium and public Wikipedia evidence do not certify arbitrary sites; native Chrome access/accessibility, actual screen-reader speech, real Gemini Nano quality, and signed-in workflows remain separate acceptance.

nodes.label: Single worker-owned session and journey
nodes.description: worker-runtime composes memory, vision, journey, attachment, routing, frames, and navigation services around live access to one mutable pinned session and one serialized queue.
nodes.rationale: Service extraction cannot introduce parallel session caches or competing journey owners.

nodes.label: Stable generated browser entrypoints
nodes.description: Build preserves worker.js, content.js, frame-agent.js, offscreen.js, inference.js, ocr-worker.js, sidepanel.js, and theme-page.js.

nodes.label: Content runtime and PageCoach facade
nodes.description: Top runtime and PageCoach orchestrate observation, binding, plan lifecycle, outcome verification, frame agents, and visual guidance.

nodes.label: Single session snapshot subscription
nodes.description: useSessionSnapshot owns one snapshot subscription and bounded fallback; controllers and features receive typed state/actions without duplicate inference or polling.

nodes.label: Privilege-free shared presentation
nodes.description: packages/ui owns Guide/Conversation, attention, composer, route nodes, Wayfinder, and responsive priority; accepts state/callbacks and cannot access Chrome, credentials, permissions, or outcome authority.

nodes.label: Extension guidance composition
nodes.description: Controller composes feature actions and dedicated hooks while sidebar-only privileged settings remain outside embedded shared presentation.

nodes.label: Revision-protected draft restoration
nodes.description: Local edit revisions and matching UI_SAVE acknowledgement protect typing from stale reads and replies; surface handoff can restore a clean draft without changing the journey.

nodes.label: Session-bound isolated widget shell
nodes.description: Closed-shadow shell owns clamped geometry/pointer capture and trusted typed layout actions; extension-origin iframe owns guidance and its Widget menu, with keyboard alternatives.

nodes.label: State-preserving widget density
nodes.description: Density depends on usable width/height with immediate reduction and buffered expansion; shared components stay mounted and draft, selection, and focus survive tier changes.

nodes.label: Isolated website practice adapter
nodes.description: Shadow-root embedded GuidanceApp consumes controlled sample outcomes and callbacks; the practice has no Chrome permissions or production journey ownership.

nodes.label: Recorded product media versus brand motion
nodes.description: Marketing consumes a genuine recording manifest; capture requires a real worker-verified public-page result and immutable hashes, while brand motion emits no journey/completion evidence.

nodes.label: Allowlisted safe website documentation
nodes.description: Lazy docs registry permits selected Markdown, local search and explicit reference aliases; raw HTML is disabled, images become source links, and initial Home avoids repository Markdown.

nodes.label: Website history and heading-aware routing
nodes.description: App router separates pathname/query/fragment, preserves modified clicks/Back/scroll, waits for lazy headings/fragments, and bounds/cancels observers and animation frames.

nodes.label: Passive geometry-bound guidance overlay
nodes.description: Closed-shadow overlay ignores pointer input and accessibility tree; one frame loop tracks the fresh target rectangle without decorative interpolation, clears hidden targets, and cancels on Pause/Stop.

nodes.label: Meaningful polite status and focus management
nodes.description: Panel supplies equivalent instruction/progress in one polite atomic region; polling/geometry do not repeat announcements, and Guide/Pause/Stop manage focus predictably.

nodes.label: Independent geometry and keyboard evidence
nodes.description: Browser tests independently inspect overlay geometry via CDP across movement/zoom/edges/reduced motion and check keyboard focus/status behavior; this does not prove native screen-reader speech.

nodes.label: Feature-local website ownership
nodes.description: App owns routing/history, SiteLayout navigation/footer, practice sample state, legal its canonical content/operator details, and docs stable public article aliases.

nodes.label: Stable public documentation aliases
nodes.description: Public article slugs survive repository moves through explicit legacy-reference aliases; historical evidence remains a repository link.

nodes.label: Offline local default
nodes.description: Packaged English MiniLM and Tesseract run locally on CPU with no cloud model/backend or user account required; optional Chrome/backend integrations remain separate opt-ins.

nodes.label: Deterministic PR validation gate
nodes.description: npm run test:ci builds once and validates deterministic PR behavior; focused existing checks guide implementation and prepared builds require immutable verified artifacts.

nodes.label: Same-run exact-byte release certification
nodes.description: Full-tier evidence must cover the final build before packaging. Do not rebuild afterward, overwrite existing archives, or aggregate focused historical reports as certification.
nodes.rationale: Independent or historical test evidence cannot certify different artifact bytes.

nodes.label: Frozen evaluation corpora
nodes.description: Original fixture bytes, splits, hashes, and thresholds are preserved; calibration needs explicit versioning/independent review and predictions cannot regenerate expectations.

nodes.label: Stable legacy compatibility identifiers
nodes.description: Product copy uses Tholi while scoped packages, storage keys, environment variables, and protocol identifiers retain legacy names for compatibility.

nodes.label: Pinned third-party model and discovery provenance
nodes.description: Bundled license texts and generated third-party.json describe pinned dependencies; MiniLM revision, adapted Playwright hashes, OCR assets, and experimental Paddle/OpenCV adaptations have explicit provenance.

nodes.label: Historical evidence versus current behavior
nodes.description: Versioned records describe specific tested bytes and are neither current installation instructions nor broad current reliability guarantees.
nodes.rationale: Evidence must remain attached to the tested version/build, with current behavior and pending acceptance stated separately.

hyperedges.label: Live evidence and guidance cycle
hyperedges.evidence: The architecture flowchart connects live DOM discovery, validated observation, core planning, binding, task-specific checks, and browser knowledge.

hyperedges.label: Shared presentation with separate runtime authorities
hyperedges.evidence: Frontend ownership assigns journeys to the worker, observation/verification to content, callbacks to presentation, and sample outcomes to the isolated practice adapter.

hyperedges.label: Private session versus reusable structural knowledge
hyperedges.evidence: Persistence and vision/backend sections explicitly separate temporary private task/OCR context from reusable sanitized knowledge and derived indexes, applying the same policy to optional mirroring.
